messages.text: Morning all. Quick question on mobile deposit holds: I have {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0069}} on the line, check deposited via the app yesterday afternoon and it's showing a hold on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00149}}. What's our standard hold window for new-ish mobile deposits again?

Standard is next business day for the first $225, then the rest on the second business day, unless an exception hold applies. Check the hold reason code in CoreBanking, it should tell you which one fired.
Reason code says 'large deposit' threshold. Amount was $4,800. Account has been open since 2023 and no returns that I can see.
Over $5k aggregate in a day usually triggers it, but if there were two deposits yesterday that could stack. Check the deposit history for the day, not just the one item.
Yep, there was a second smaller one that morning. That pushes it over. Makes sense now.

Reminder for everyone: if you're releasing a mobile deposit hold early, it needs a documented reason in the note and a second look from a Member Advocate or me if it's over $2,500. Auditors flagged this last quarter.
Thanks Paul. Is the second look required before release or can we document and have it reviewed same day?
Before release, Joanna. Same-day review is only for the under $2,500 range. Ping the channel and one of us will grab it fast.
So for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0069}}, I'm going to leave the hold and explain the timing. Funds should be fully available tomorrow. Member seems okay with it, just wanted the explanation.

Heads up, I have {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0014}} calling about a mobile deposit hold too. This is one of my members and the account is flagged high risk, so I'm not releasing anything without checking with Compliance first.
Good call. Does the hold on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00028}} show an exception code or just the standard one?
Exception code, repeated deposits plus the risk rating. I'll tell the member it's under routine review and we'll follow up, without getting into specifics.
Right, no need to say more than that. If they ask for a callback number, confirm the one on file {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0014}} rather than taking a new one over the phone.
Agreed, verified already. I'll send the note over to Compliance and log the call in MemberCRM.
Can someone add a short mobile deposit hold cheat sheet to the floor wiki? Standard windows, the large deposit rule, and who to ping for early release approvals. I'd like it up by Friday.
I'll draft it this afternoon and tag Nichole and Joanna to review before it goes live.
